messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: node hyperion-rack7-gpu13 lost kubelet heartbeat (no heartbeat for 45s). podPressure=true; automated remediation: none. Pager: PagerDuty -> oncall

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: [INCIDENT] hyperion-rack7-gpu13 - kubelet_unhealthy fired -> /incidents/PD-6983 (page sent)

ajay (on-call): acked. I'm on it. grabbing serial console.

olivia (sre): thx ajay. quick context: we just had a small spike in evictions in the gpu pool, looks correlated w/ this host. customers may have retried to fallback pool.

ajay (on-call): seeing kubelet NotReady on the node: `Kubelet stopped posting status` in kube-event. Trying kubectl describe node.

ajay (on-call): run:```bash
kubectl -n kube-system get pod -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=hyperion-rack7-gpu13
kubectl describe node hyperion-rack7-gpu13
```

ajay (on-call): describe shows repeated CRI errors + docker/containerd timeouts, and dmesg has NVMe error + kernel oops trace fragment. attaching snippet:```
[ 12345.678901] nvme0: I/O 0 QID 0 timeout, reset controller
[ 12345.679002] kernel: oom_kill_process+0x1f7/0x2c0
[ 12346.000111] kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: Attempted to kill init! cpu 3
```

olivia (sre): ouch. could be a partial hardware failure -> kubelet becomes flaky. Suggest cordon + drain and fail over workloads. Prepare allow-reboot flag if infra agrees.

ajay (on-call): starting cordon/drain to minimize customer impact.

ajay (on-call):```bash
kubectl cordon hyperion-rack7-gpu13
kubectl drain hyperion-rack7-gpu13 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```

ajay (on-call): drain in progress, some pods are stuck on SIGTERM due to model checkpoint cleanup. forcing eviction in 2m if not done.

marco (runtime): FYI we've routed traffic away from that host via the smart-router policy; some in-flight sessions got retried to dedicated-pool-2. Telemetry: ~0.8% of requests saw >2s extra latency in the last 6m.

olivia (sre): can you post the metrics/dash link? we need to include customer impact in the incident ticket.

marco (runtime): dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/9a1/gpu-pool?orgId=1&panelId=12&from=-15m&to=now

ajay (on-call): drain still hung on 3 stateful pods; killing them to unblock (they will restart on other nodes). executing: `kubectl delete pod --force --grace-period=0 <pod>`

ajay (on-call): serial console connect shows DSS/POST errors; I kicked BMC power cycle (ipmitool chassis power cycle). Watch for node to come back.

lee (infra-lead): +1 to reboot after drain completes. sounds like NVMe/controller health. I'll open a hardware ticket with hosting and request replacement if it fails POST.

ajay (on-call): node now rebooting (BMC accepted power-cycle). watching for kubelet ready. if it doesn't register in 4m we'll escalate to full host replacement.

incident-bot: UPDATE: PagerDuty PD-6983 status -> acknowledged by ajay (on-call). Next escalation in 12 minutes if no resolution.

marco (runtime): placed temporary placement policy to prefer dedicated-pool-1 for model_inference jobs from affected customers to reduce risk of retries.

olivia (sre): customer comms: we should post a short note to #support with impact: brief outage/reroute for small % of inference calls; suggested text: 'We experienced transient routing for GPU inference tied to a single host failure; most requests retried successfully, small latency degradation for ~10 minutes. Engineers are replacing the host.' Want me to post?

ajay (on-call): yes please post. include that canary traffic was redirected and SLA unaffected but we'll continue to monitor.

olivia (sre): posting to #support now. :mailbox_with_mail:

ajay (on-call): kubelet came back briefly but crashed again with same oops. collecting full journalctl and /var/log/kern.log and uploading: https://s3.internal.redwood/logs/hyperion-rack7-gpu13/2423456789-logs.tar.gz

lee (infra-lead): thanks — I filed HW ticket HT-4421 and requested onsite replacement if POST continues to fail.

ajay (on-call): creating incident ticket: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026 linked to PD-6983. Adding logs + metrics + timeline.

olivia (sre): handoff note for next oncall (marco): node unstable, reboots attempted, drain completed, pods evicted/restarted elsewhere, hardware ticket open. If node fails POST again, do not re-add to pool — wait for infra replacement.

marco (runtime): taking over the watch. I'll follow up in 20m and coordinate with infra for replacement.

ajay (on-call): handing off to marco. marking PD incident as 'in progress - oncall handed off'.

incident-bot: RESOLVE CHECK: node hyperion-rack7-gpu13 remains NotReady. PD-6983 will remain open until hardware confirmed.

olivia (sre): adding runbook tags and next steps to the incident: runbook#kernel-panic -> escalate to infra, gather logs, replace host.

marco (runtime): noted. I'll add a short postmortem stub and link to logs/timeline for SRE review tomorrow.

lee (infra-lead): thanks team. I'll coordinate replacement slot. keep PD open until physical confirmation. :white_check_mark:

marco (runtime): monitoring. last check: percent of rerouted requests returned to baseline ~8 minutes after initial page. will update if anything changes.

ajay (on-call): signing off from active response — handing full ownership to marco.

marco (runtime): ack, will post follow-ups.

olivia (sre): closing handoff. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
